meta.title: Koide Ski Resort
meta.description: Five minutes from Kan-etsu Uonuma IC — zero-lost-children compact slopes and adjacent Michibra no Yu Komami hot spring. Perfect for family snow debuts.

hero.title:
Koide
Ski Resort
hero.tagline: The perfect family snow debut with zero-lost-children slopes and a scenic hot spring.

transit.title:
Five minutes from Uonuma IC,
walkable from Koide Station.
transit.lead: About 5 minutes by car from Kan-etsu Expressway Uonuma IC (renamed from Koide IC in 2024). About 10 minutes on foot from JR Joetsu / Oigawa Line Koide Station — ideal for drivers wary of snowy roads and Oigawa Line transit visitors seeking a quick snow play stop.
transit.imgAlt: Winter drive from Kan-etsu Uonuma IC toward Koide town and snowy slopes — easy access is the draw

primary.title: Zero lost children × compact bowl terrain
primary.lead: Mortar-bowl topography keeps kids within sight — a long-running zero-lost-children record. Perfect for first snow, school lessons, and sled play. Shorter runs (except the 1,000 m Usagi course) suit snow-play-focused stays.
primary.imgAlt: Compact slopes at Koide Ski Resort — safe bowl terrain for families

secondary.title: Warm, approachable hospitality
secondary.lead: Staff skilled from years of school ski programs earn consistent praise for kindness — an emotional driver for repeat visits (report analysis).

pass.title:
After skiing,
Komami's scenic rotenburo.
pass.lead: Bundled ticket concept: full-day lift, Michibra no Yu Komami entry, and Koide station-area food coupons (LP proposal). Keeps visitors spending across the area instead of heading straight home.
pass.noticeBody: Discount vouchers at partner eateries near Koide Station (Fukuitei, Daizen, etc.) with lift tickets — a half-day to full-day Uonuma itinerary (report ch.5).
pass.imgAlt: Ski and Michibra no Yu Komami bundled — Uonuma day-trip model

rental.title:
Arrive empty-handed,
play in the snow.
rental.lead: Oigawa Line visitor package: hands-free snow play plus Komami onsen — leverage walkable access from Koide Station for a few-hour experience (report proposal).
rental.whisper: Multilingual POP at the station and tourist desk to capture gap-time visitors.
rental.imgAlt: Family starting snow play with rental gear — hands-free visit image

yukinko.title:
Saturday night ski
overlooking town.
yukinko.lead: Night-lit runs like Kitsune course overlook Uonuma town — night skiing and adjacent hot springs offset shorter daytime runs.
yukinko.whisper: Mid-term proposal: Snow & Sauna events with Michibra no Yu Komami (report ch.7).
yukinko.imgAlt: Night-lit slopes at Koide Ski Resort — Uonuma winter evening

family.title:
First snow,
without getting lost.
family.lead: Center plaza sled and tube zone, Tanuki course for warm-ups, 80% beginner–intermediate runs — overwhelming peace of mind for families with young children.
family.noticeBody: Steep log stairs from parking to slopes are the top pain point — weekend cargo/child shuttle is a short-term fix proposal (report ch.7).
family.imgAlt: Family sledding — center plaza at Koide Ski Resort

spa.title:
After skiing,
open-air bath with Echigo Sanzan views.
spa.lead: Adjacent day-use hot spring Michibra no Yu Komami — chloride and sulfate waters that stay warm, with open-air baths facing Echigo Sanzan. Good access from Risusan course too.
spa.whisper: Combine with Yu-Park Yakushi or Juwa Onsen across Uonuma city.
spa.imgAlt: Michibra no Yu Komami rotenburo — après-ski Echigo Sanzan views

workation.title:
Morning snow,
noon food street, evening bath.
workation.lead: Morning snow at Koide → lunch near Koide Station (Fukuitei, Mont Blanc) → evening soak at Michibra no Yu Komami — half-day to full-day Uonuma loop (report ch.5).

local.title: Zero-lost-children × adjacent onsen guide
local.body: Visualize IC proximity and compact terrain with mobile LP and live ops — strengthen positioning for beginners and families (report ch.7).

schools.title: Uonuma gourmet loop coupons
schools.body: Discount vouchers at partner eateries near Koide Station with lift purchases — boost area-wide spending and stay time (report ch.7).

summer.title: Oigawa Line × Koide snow play
summer.body: Capture Oigawa Line snow-scenery demand — position as a walkable local snow spot from Koide Station with hands-free packages (report ch.6).
